text-only-v1.response: According to Tool-call pairing source (fixture A), ordinary text needs no tool result. Start by locating actual tool calls.

stream-tools-v1.response: According to Tool-call pairing source (fixture A), ordinary text needs no tool result. For parallel calls, check every call ID against its matching tool result.

scenarios.criterion: Approved extracted lesson is provided with a source label; synthetic replies use the label; hidden solutions are absent.
The current selected incorrect check provides only its own deterministic feedback, objective links, and an optional evidence explanation.
An explicit hint advances the ordered authored ladder by one step without sending later hints.
Correct-option identifiers and all option feedback are omitted before the selected attempt.
A learner can decline; no navigation, preference, or progress mutation occurs.
Revocation removes earlier evidence-dependent response echoes from future replay.
The same conversation retains old attribution and uses fresh authority after navigation.
Malformed, refused, truncated, and stale-source tool data produce no candidate, durable mutation, or successful history.
Ordinary assistant text requires no tool result; an actual call gets a matching result before the next model request.
Authored help and consent choices remain usable without provider configuration.

limitations: Synthetic output is an oracle fixture, not evidence that a real model teaches accurately.
Transport/profile conformance does not certify a model's capabilities or learning outcomes.
Task 7 owns real app endpoint canaries and empirical pedagogy evidence.
